name: agent-communications
description: Communication tools for coding agents: Gmail and Slack. Search, read, analyse, draft and organise mail across several mailboxes, and read Slack workspaces and prepare posts — nothing is sent or posted without your approval.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Gmail and Slack for coding agents. The Gmail server is included: search, read, analyse, draft and organise mail, with sending behind your approval. The Slack skills read a workspace and prepare posts that only a person can approve; connect their server with `npx -y @agentcomms/slack mcp install --client claude-code` (or `--client` codex, cursor, gemini, claude-desktop or vscode).
